_readme: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR TRIAGE SCORING.
Both runtimes read this file, so the rule cannot drift between them:
backend   -> Backend/model.py    (loads it by relative path)
Why it lives under src/data: Vite can import JSON only from inside the
frontend root without extra config, and Python can read it from anywhere.
Putting it in a top-level shared/ folder would mean widening Vite's
Change a weight or a threshold here and BOTH engines move together.
After any change run, in order:
1. node scripts/check-scoring-parity.mjs   (frontend still matches this file)
Nothing here is clinically validated. The weights are round numbers chosen to
make a demo legible; they are not derived from any guideline or outcome data.
description: Additive 0-15 triage score over vitals and reported symptoms.
_classWeightNote: Passed to LogisticRegression as class_weight. Both models predict the three
bands above directly, so there is no probability threshold to tune.
"balanced" was chosen for triage asymmetry: it lifts HIGH recall from 64% to
84% on the held-out split, at the cost of ~3 points of overall agreement. A
false HIGH over-escalates; a missed HIGH sends an emergency patient home.
Set to null for the maximum-agreement variant - see docs/evaluation.md.
